name: ios-cli-trainer
description: Web-based Cisco IOS CLI typing trainer

scripts.build:grammar: node -e "const yaml = require('js-yaml'); const fs = require('fs'); const switch2960 = yaml.load(fs.readFileSync('commands-2960-switch.yaml', 'utf8')); const router1941 = yaml.load(fs.readFileSync('commands-1941-router.yaml', 'utf8')); fs.writeFileSync('web/public/commands-2960-switch.json', JSON.stringify(switch2960, null, 2)); fs.writeFileSync('web/public/commands-1941-router.json', JSON.stringify(router1941, null, 2)); console.log('Built grammars for: 2960-switch, 1941-router');"
scripts.web:build: npm run build:grammar && cd web && npm run build
